source.title: Price Path Continuity and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
source.author: Woong Bae Kim

hypothesis: Short-term crypto returns exhibit continuation when accumulated through smooth continuous paths. A signed path-continuity score should predict next-week cross-sectional returns.
universe: Frozen ex-ante Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals listed by 2021-12-31. Each Monday retain top 50 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume.
feature: Over prior W completed daily returns compute PRET=product(1+r)-1 and path_efficiency=abs(sum(r))/sum(abs(r)); signal=PRET*path_efficiency.
portfolio: Equal-weight market-neutral long top signal quintile and short bottom signal quintile, 0.5 gross each side.
execution: Inputs end Sunday; rebalance Monday 00:00 UTC open and hold to next Monday open.
development_gate: Canonical mean rank IC >0.02 with HAC p<0.05, positive high-minus-low spread, canonical net Sharpe >0.70 and total return >0, and at least 2/3 lookbacks positive.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; OOS rank IC >0.02; positive at 2x costs; at least 2/3 lookbacks positive; both OOS years non-negative; max drawdown <35%; breadth robustness positive; DSR reported.
source_deviation: The source uses a Rank-Weighted PPC measure. Exact rank weighting was not available in accessible source text, so this transparent path-efficiency proxy was fixed before results.
